title: Dean Curnutt - The Reflexivity of Equity Volatility (S6E16)
summary:
In this episode, I speak with Dean Kernut, founder of macro risk advisors and host of the
Alpha Exchange podcast. This episode is all about the nature of risk. More
specifically, the endogenous risk that can manifest in markets.

thesis: The episode discusses the nature of risk, endogenous risk, and market crises, citing examples such as the 1987 crash, LTCM, the 2008 financial crisis, the 2018 XIV implosion, and the 2020 COVID crisis. It explores related topics including reflexivity, crowding, risk recycling, and the evolving role of the Federal Reserve.
